body.prose: What is your best take on dimensions? Because I've given so much background around it. But I think with the right reasoning, you'd be able to ontologically break apart all of the needs and the requirements, etc., come up with a reasonable approach. Because, I mean, the kind of dimensions I'm thinking about, they've only been thought about in the realm of having only briefs. But now we are upon all the primitives. Now we're talking about the [OpenLight] successor, so maybe there's another way of looking upon it, but I think ultimately the story as to why I'd like something like that's clear. Now the question is, what is the right open-ended way of meeting those needs?
body.title: The right open-ended way to dimensions
